book.name: Mak
book.title: God ol wai ol na tongwo ha i Mak bol engwo dimia

content: Yisas yal ta kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongure si hobale olungwo ha
Ena yalhobi sipi ala molere, hon ere Gerasa ganba bina ongwi.
Pirere Yisas ere mena ungure, yal ta kwia nigi dongwo yong sina momia, u pa dungure, hangwi.
Yal iwe, ari yulagi engwo bani mol pai olere, nona pangure, kebereng aling han waiya sungure, kunu ta paikima.
Hamen haung haung han sungure, si oulu di ole ole, mongwi.
Molere girungwo tangwo yulagi engwo hulu grang ali pare pare, hamen hul i moni mole, hai mere, gala dire dire mongwi. Molere, pegare ole, hulu kebereng aling bol kula hala sire sire mongwi.
Ena yal i mole hamba, Yisas ulubi ire u pa dungwo hanere, bli si pire, ya manbi habilai sire, gala dire yu dungwi,
“Yisas, God wangye, ni tal ol na terala di pire une? Na hana pamia, ni hani pamo?
God mongwo ipire gauna gul honagi ol na tekio.” Dimia Yisas homa kwia nigi dongwo mena po ditomiraya ha i ya pai mongwi.
Mongure Yisas hon sirin bol tongwi, “Ni han dalo,” dungwi. “Na hana Kwia Miki Weni molia, taniga ta molkiwa.”
Direre Yisas di tere, “Na yalhobi ganba baniya ta u mena honaminia ni na hobale olekio.”
Dire hangure, kun miki weni emin ne mongure, hangwi.
Hanere sirin bol tere yu dungwi, “Ni na hobale olingere, kun yong sina i naminba?”

Dungure, Yisas “Owa, para dinia, po,” ditongwi. Ditongure, ari yong sina aidole, ere mena pire, kun yong sina ongwi. Ongure, kun hobi miki weni tu tausen mole, daang i nulu di wi ime pire, nir digan bir saagu dire, gol wai sungwi.
Simia kun kene ongwo yalhobi iwe, te ongwi. Pire, tal ongwo ha i, ditongure, ari para weni pungwi.
Pirere, harala dire, Yisas mongwo bani ongwi. Pirere hangure, kwia nigi dongwo yong sina mongwo yal i krau pirere, yamoni mole ami di mongure hangwi.
Hanere, kul pungwi. Pungure tal ongwo i di tibi ol tongwi.
Tongure pirere, “Na ganbana bani pisolere, ere banta po.”
Ditongure, Yisas ere sipi ala nala di ungure, kwia yong sina mongure si doling i ole tongwo yali ure, sirin bol tere, “Na kina ereho namne?” dungwi.
Dimba Yisas mana dire yu ditongwi, “Ni nin ere gaminahobo mongwo malgi po. Pirere, God tal ol ni tere miling pir ni tongwo i, di tibi olana po.”
Ditongure, yali ere pire, tal ol tongwo maing di tibi olere, Dikapolis ganba bani molere, boling kul tibi olungwi. Olungure ari hobi molere, tal ongwo ha i, pirere, yo yangwi.
Yisas Ami kene ongwo yal ta aung si hon e tere te al ta Yisas gal sina are u wai ongwo ire dire ha
Ena Yisas ere sipi bani hon pirere, pi nir bina hoibi hol bani ongwi. Pi mongure ari tabin bir weni u ku bole mongwi.
Mongure, yal Yairas Yuda ari ha maing oo kene ongwo yali urere, Yisas gumang hanere, kebering gulung bolere sirin bol tere yu dungwi,
“Na auna migi irai nibil bir ole, golala di omia, ni ure gaung bani angere, si hon ere ya monamia wo.”
Dungure, Yisas yali kina ereho ongwi. Ongure, ari tabin bir hobi kri di u ku bolere, yobile sina ole mongwi.
Mongure, al ta kina doling bol ongwi. Ena airing iwe, algi bilere mongwi. Algi iwe, omaga ta bilkima. Me erin ana holo holo kebena sutani twelpela yia bil mongwo bani mongwi.
Ena ari dokta miki weni ure honagi ol tongure, airing i, moni bir kara pi dokta mongwo bani gongwi. Gombawe, nibil i wai ta sikima.

Hon u bir weni ongure mongwi. Molere, “Yisas gia ta yu omua,” dungwo pungwi. Pirere, u mongwo bani ungwi. Umba, ari taporal yobile sina ole mongwi. Mongure, al i haya u mobing hol urere, aling sine dire, galsina ongwo bani angwi.
Arere, yu nomani si pungwi, “Na Yisas galsina ongwo bani aga i, nibil wai sinamia,” di pungwi.
Ena yu ongure, nibil iwe, gintani wai sungwo ya moni mongwi. Mole, nin nomani si pungure, yong miling sina i para u wai ongure pungwi.
Ena yu ongure, Yisas na yulana obilga ura di dimia di pire, inaa dire, sirin bol tere yu dungwi, “Na mobina holi ara ure galsina ame?”
Dungure, gamahobi yu ditongwi, “Ari miki weni ure, ni yobile i sina olimia talongure galsina ama dine?”
Dungure, Yisas ari mongwo bane hobi han wabo dire, angwo yal gumang harala dire wa dungwi.
Dungure, al i u wai oiya di pirere, si pilo dire, gaung nungure, ure, Yisas mongwo bani ungwi. Urere, ya habilai sire, ha weni di ba bole di tibi olungwi.
Olungure, Yisas yu ditongwi, “Auna ye, ni na awai ol na tenangwo u wai nala di pire pir na tenga meri u wai pire monia. Ni kul pirikio. Nibil i kara wai simia, yon ura dinangure molo.”
Ena Yisas ha i di te mongure, Yuda ha maing oo kene ongwo yal Yairus gamahobo tau ure, yu ditongwi, “Ni aun haya gomia, ni Tisa talwe di te mone?”
Yu dimba Yisas ha dungwo i pir tekima. Tekire Yairas yu ditongwi, “Ni nigi de pirkio. Yon ura dire, na onangwo pamia di pir na tere molo.”
Yu dire, ari hobi molo dire, hobang si tongwi. Si tere, Pita ire, Yems ire, ebering Yon ire dire, obil aule ire ongwi.
Pirere, pi ya singaba Yairas oo malgi pa dungwi. Pa dire, hangure, ari miki weni hai mere, pegare ole mongwi.
Ena Yisas hanere, yu ditongwi, “Ni yalhobi talongwo hai me mone? Ama i ta golkimia. Ya moni ul pai momua.”

Yu dungure, ari hobi wa gol tongwi. Tombawe, Yisas ala pire, ari mongwo hobi “Ere maini po,” ditongwi. Diterere, aang ire, irang ire, te gamahobo ya sui tai di ire dire, pi werang ta ama i pai mongwo bani ongwi.
Pirere, ama i aleng aki dire, yu ditongwi, “Amagir ye, airo.”
Ena yu dungure, ama i gintani aire, yamoni mole, hol wangwi. Wangure, me erin iwe, ana holo holo kebena sutani twelpela yia mongwi. Mongure, ari hobi hanere, yo yangwi.
Ena Yisas ha di nima pire yu ditongwi, “Na tal olga i, ari hawai ol tekio. Ama migi homena nenamia to,” dungwi.
